name: Preemptible-GPU inference made safe by portable session state
one_line: Run long-lived agent sessions on spot GPUs by keeping every session's KV state portable off-instance, so a preemption becomes a bit-identical restore on another instance instead of a lost session; value is continuity and fleet capacity at 64k-128k+ context, not TTFT, and the deciding number (restore bandwidth from a tier that survives the instance) is unmeasured.

founder_decisions.decision: Model and tensor-parallel class for the MVP
founder_decisions.options: 7-8B or 30B-A3B at TP=1 (the only validated regime) vs GLM-5.2 / Kimi-K3-class MoE at TP=8 (where public agent traffic is; KV replicated 8x per llm-d)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Trades measured portability today against the market's actual model sizes; informed by the TP>1 experiment and design-partner model choices, not by the evidence ledgers

founder_decisions.decision: GPU class and cloud provider for the spot fleet
founder_decisions.options: H100/B200 at hyperscalers (57-81% Spot discount, 0-120 s notice) vs A100/L40S at AWS (16-19% off) vs neocloud on-demand near hyperscaler Spot (H100 median $3.39) vs Azure H200 (no Spot discount); single-cloud vs cross-provider arbitrage
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Depends on unmeasured GPU-pool interruption rates and on the founder's tolerance for provider concentration; the price sheet informs it, the 7-day interruption log would inform it further

founder_decisions.options: Treat LMCache S3 backend, vLLM OffloadingConnector object tier, llm-d P2P, Dynamo KVBM G4 and production-stack's 'request migration' roadmap as a closing window vs as a gap (none ships a spot-session product per the research files)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The founder's hard rule: a competitor's existence does not disqualify a direction; facts are stated neutrally in Section 9 and the judgment is the founder's

founder_decisions.decision: Hosted service vs BYOC vs open-source connector
founder_decisions.options: Hosted (captures the spot margin, needs fleet ops); BYOC (sells connector + control plane into the customer's own spot fleet; compose recipe exists in dexa_platform); OSS connector following the LMCache-to-Tensormesh path
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: A business-model choice; no survey of self-host share exists in the research files, so design-partner interviews rather than repo evidence would inform it

founder_decisions.decision: Which agent segment to target first
founder_decisions.options: Coding agents (128k contexts, human gaps to 20 min); computer-use agents; back-office agents; voice (2.5k contexts, 300 ms p95 gate) where portable KV adds nothing on speed
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: A market-size and go-to-market judgment the founder reserved; the evidence only says where re-prefill is expensive enough for restore to matter

founder_decisions.decision: Whether to sell determinism (bit-identical continuation) at small context
founder_decisions.options: Offer identical-continuation as a product feature for audit/replay buyers at <=16k where TTFT loses vs re-prefill, or ignore small contexts entirely
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Buyer value of determinism is unmeasured; it is a positioning choice, not an engineering result

founder_decisions.decision: Meter shape for the preemptible tier
founder_decisions.options: Per token at a spot-derived rate with a restore SLO; per running session-hour (Managed Agents shape, $0.08/hr); 30% of estimated savings (Tensormesh post-v1 formula); admission-gated discount (Morph Standby shape)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Pricing strategy; the architecture makes each expressible but the evidence does not rank them, and the margin depends on the unmeasured spot-economics experiment
